goal: Stop using an unmaintained external seed list for release seed generation
Prevent stale peer data and address poisoning if the domain is abandoned or hijacked
agreement: Awaiting confirmation on whether the operator has permanently stepped away

categories.name: tools
why: P3 because removing an unmaintained seed source is routine maintenance
It protects future release seeds from stale peers and domain hijacking
Dropping one inactive source has marginal impact and is easily deferrable
